prompts.task: Copy genai-default-audit.json into matching canonical .observe/otel-audit.json, validate it and request OTEL-001 using the bundled selection flow. This task asks for a concrete implementation plan only: write .observe/genai-default-implementation-plan.md for the selected live-agent finding and the source scenarios in genai-default-scenarios.json. Determine the default producer rather than asking me to select a library; identify real source boundaries, supported version/example APIs, required fields, configured redaction and focused tests. Preserve existing OTel/Galileo paths in those scenarios. Do not modify application/dependency/config/test files, start services, install packages or call models/cloud; do not create successful implementation or runtime verification claims from this plan. Treat app.py and each producer source snapshot as separate source cases. Also explicitly assess genai-required-evidence.json as a separate captured synthetic case, including safe-call-1, the independent auxiliary request timeout with no ended inference/error span, ordinary HTTP/ASGI/auth/SQL helpers, and HTTP200 with rejectedSpans1; those facts do not establish that app.py contains those operations. Use genai-sdk-source-snapshot.json and genai-semconv-source-snapshot.json as dated official-source evidence when this sandbox cannot access the network. Record exact file paths, resolved revisions and capture dates, proposed SDK compatibility and the distinction between a captured-main snapshot and a new live latest lookup. Do not claim unavailable installed/runtime or future-main proof. Assess actual content and requirements across the artifacts in any concise equivalent structure; a table heading alone is not evidence. Explicitly apply source-specific operation counts: the export_only_fresh_agent snapshot contains only turn(messages, client) -> client.chat(messages=messages), with no tool call or workflow invocation. Its operation plan and acceptance tests must require no tool/workflow operation nodes unless later source actually adds such operations; do not ask for one of each model/tool node or use a generic source-only guardrail to excuse contradictory per-case counts. For actual app.py, call_provider is an in-process sleep/calculation stub with no external model request. Record that topology and distinguish proposed SDK span-kind mapping from source/runtime proof; a future remote CLIENT interpretation must be conditional on an actual remote provider boundary and kept separate from the captured synthetic fixture's known separate-process model. Do not force an unsupported SDK API/kind, change business behavior or introduce operations solely to satisfy telemetry.

judge_inputs: Inspect app.py, eval_runner.py, the unchanged provided source/telemetry snapshots, loaded skill sources and generated .observe reports/plan; evaluate actual per-scenario decisions and field assessments, not copied skill wording.

Evaluate the actual facts across canonical and supplemental artifacts, not exact headings/table layout. Compare app.py source separately from each synthetic input case. Dated official snapshots are allowed offline provenance; do not demand live network calls, installed SDK proof for a proposed plan, or fabricated existing capture configuration. Do not score missing SDK provenance again under the final role-specific criterion.
rubric: Selects Splunk AO span creation by default for the actual fresh interactive agent and export-only-fresh snapshot, while preserving existing OTel and Galileo GenAI producers/provider/export paths and filling only their gaps. Evaluation-only SDK usage and generic HTTP/provider setup do not establish live GenAI coverage.

Treats applicable safe content and vendor fields as required acceptance, preserving official Opt-In provenance. Per operation identifies source availability, concrete proposed numeric message/part/UTF-8 limits or a known stricter policy and a named boundary before every SDK/exporter for redaction. Source-unavailable values have exact reasons and acceptance tests. Generic bounded/redacted wording alone is insufficient; metadata-only, placeholders, fabricated zeros and forbidden raw content never close coverage.

Reconciles the supplied dated official OTel requirements/schemas with both Galileo and Splunk AO recommendation sources, identifying exact source provenance and unavailable newer live freshness honestly. Keeps OTel Opt-In levels distinct from the required skill profile, states vendor INTERNAL-agent provider and tool arguments/input-message plus result/output-message mappings or supported OpenInference equivalents, and uses current typed-parts schemas. Embedded system-role history is not fabricated as separate API instructions. Do not fail only because equivalent evidence appears in prose or another artifact instead of a specific table.

Names source-backed SplunkAOLogger creators or a supported matching framework integration at actual fresh agent/model/tool/applicable workflow boundaries, and preserves exact existing hooks for instrumented cases. Records a concrete official example file path, snapshot or live resolved revision/date and a matching installed or explicitly proposed SDK version/API. The supplied dated official-main snapshot is valid offline source evidence when identified as such; live networking and successful SDK installation are not required in this task. Unknown live freshness/runtime support remains Not proven. A directory URL or an unsupported claim that latest main was checked is insufficient; processor-only setup does not create GenAI operations.

Assesses each source case and the separate captured-evidence case without laundering fixture facts into app.py. Preserves one producer/node and actual parentage, safe tool-call/conversation correlation on spans, actual offered definitions and arguments/results, and error/cancel/teardown handling. App.py may correctly have no independent auxiliary operation, but the supplied synthetic auxiliary timeout with no ended inference/error span must be reported as a lifecycle gap. safe-call-1 requires span-only correlation; ordinary HTTP/ASGI/auth/SQL helpers are GenAI N/A. Equivalent explicit lifecycle evidence is accepted without a literal table-row requirement; absent runtime proof remains Not proven. Studio/gateway, live credentials and SDK source edits are unnecessary.

The selected live implementation plan maps actual source operations and same-span enrichment hooks to concrete input/output/tool/metadata capture paths before any exporter, without claiming code/runtime success. A real workflow or retrieval operation is required only where source shows that boundary; search_docs constant counts do not supply a query or documents. Installing an SDK or its export processor alone never satisfies the producer finding. Evaluate the actionable boundary/hook plan independently of source-provenance grading. In the export_only_fresh_agent case, plan and test acceptance match its actual turn -> client.chat source: no tool/workflow operation nodes are expected unless later source adds those operations, and generic guardrails do not override invented per-case model/tool counts. Identifies app.py call_provider as the in-process sleep/calculation stub; does not claim source-proven remote CLIENT execution from its label or from the separate captured fixture. Any proposed future remote CLIENT topology is conditional on actual remote source and compatible SDK mapping; no unsupported kind/API or invented source operation is forced.
